clips.title: The story
paras: Recovered from a drowned skeleton beneath the shattered arches of the Thandol Span, this waterlogged letter contains the dying words of a dwarven soldier named Sully Balloo. Addressed to his wife Sara in Ironforge, it carries the final thoughts of a defender lost beneath the icy river waters during the battles for the bridge.

Beneath the massive stone pilings supporting the Thandol Span—the crucial land bridge linking the Wetlands to the Arathi Highlands—rests the drowned skeleton of a fallen dwarf. Still clutched in his skeletal grasp is a water-damaged envelope that barely survives handling. Written with painstaking care amid the fires of battle, the pages open with the tender phrase, 'My dear Sara...', preserving the soldier's voice long after the tides claimed him.

The Thandol Span has seen fierce fighting between Alliance forces and their enemies, from Dark Iron saboteurs to marauding warbands contesting the borderlands. Sully Balloo was one of the many dwarven soldiers sent north to defend the vital thoroughfare. When he perished beneath the waves, his fate remained unknown to his family in the mountains until a diver finally retrieved his farewell testament.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The waterlogged and war-torn envelope dissolves in your hands, leaving you with a few pages of a letter in your grasp, written with painstaking care.
The letter is addressed to a Mrs. Sara Balloo of Ironforge and begins, "My dear Sara...."

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look as though you have traveled a great distance and seen much turmoil in your time, adventurer. These times we live in are trying on the soul. What news do you bring to me now?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You say you saw my Sully pinned beneath the icy waters? Say it isn't so!
Let me read what he wrote....
